name: English Auction
summary: An ascending open-outcry auction where bidders beat the standing bid until no one will raise it.
rules_text: Each bidder has a private valuation for the object. A minimum bid increment is set and a standing bid starts at zero or a reserve price. In turn order, the current player may raise the standing bid by at least the increment or pass. The new standing bid becomes the highest bid so far and that bidder is the provisional winner. Bidding continues rotating through players who have not dropped out. When a full round passes with no new bid, the auction ends. The provisional winner wins the object and pays their last bid, earning valuation minus price; all others earn zero.
